title: S07T02 - Expose workflow, template, policy, gate, and validator extension points
description: Allow external packages to add canonical workflows, work structures, closeout policies, evidence validators, and schemas without patching Boreal core.
acceptanceCriteria: Extension assets are namespaced, validated, discoverable, and cannot shadow core IDs without an explicit compatible override contract.
Doctor validates references, permissions, schema parity, installed-file freshness, and policy conflicts.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
